title: AH Ultra 357 corn (Ultra 357): Characteristics
metaDescription: AH Ultra 357 corn is a yellow yellow GM hybrid corn variety. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: AH Ultra 357 corn is a yellow yellow GM hybrid corn variety, also sold or known as Ultra 357 or Asian Hybrid Ultra 357. It is not on the NSIC registry, so the facts here come from its seller and farm sources. It comes from Asian Hybrid Seed Technologies.

heroImage.alt: A cornfield on a hillside in Pilar, Capiz, its leaves drying close to harvest, the kind of farm where AH Ultra 357 corn is grown

blocks.text: If you came here looking for Ultra 357 or Asian Hybrid Ultra 357, this is the same corn. The facts below come from its seller and from farm sources, each one listed at the end. Compare it with the others in our [corn variety finder](/crop-varieties/corn), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [Pagtatanim ng mais, step by step](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-mais).
Key facts about AH Ultra 357 corn

blocks.caption: From its seller and farm sources

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

The registry gives no day count or trial yield for this variety. So ask the seller or your municipal agriculturist for figures from farms near you before you plan a season around it.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
The registry gives no pest or disease ratings for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit corn fields most often: [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [banded leaf and sheath blight](/diseases/banded-leaf-and-sheath-blight), [Corn downy mildew](/diseases/corn-downy-mildew), [Corn ear rot](/diseases/corn-ear-rot), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Traits in the seed:** YieldGard plus Roundup Ready (events MON810 x NK603): corn borer protection plus glyphosate tolerance, sold as 90:10 bag in bag refuge.

blocks.text: Check these against what farmers near you have seen, because the same variety can do differently from one town to the next.
Where and when to plant AH Ultra 357 corn

Start with the color your buyer pays for: yellow corn goes to feed mills, while white and glutinous corn go to the table. Next, pick between a hybrid, which yields more but needs new seed every season, and an open pollinated variety, whose seed you can save. Then match the island group in its recommendation, because trials in Luzon and Mindanao give different winners. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for corn](/land-preparation/corn-land-preparation).

items: Buy sealed packs or tagged sacks from an accredited dealer, and check the packing date and germination rate.
Ask your municipal agriculturist or nearby farmers how it did in your area last season.
Try it on a small area first, beside the variety you usually plant, before you switch the whole farm.
Write down the planting day, inputs and harvest, so you can compare varieties on your own ground. anee.io keeps these records for you.

items.q: Is Ultra 357 the same as AH Ultra 357?
items.a: Yes. Ultra 357 is another name for AH Ultra 357. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.
No. It is a hybrid, so seed saved from it does not grow true and yields less. Buy new seed each season.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of AH Ultra 357?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
